title: Image-based machine learning predicted five-year survival in rectal cancer cohorts
summary: The preprint evaluated convolutional and wavelet-scattering features from RhoB/DNp73 immunohistochemistry for five-year survival prediction in rectal-cancer cohorts. It reports a prognostic modeling result; it does not by itself establish a newly validated biomarker or clinical utility.
ai_technology: CNN features combined with wavelet-scattering representations of RhoB/DNp73 immunohistochemistry.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: The study evaluated five-year survival prediction in rectal-cancer cohorts using protein-marker image data.
evidence.unknown: Preprint prognostic analysis; cohort-specific performance and marker status require independent clinical validation.
